message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Standard Edition)**  

---

### 1. Objective  
Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in your hand during each round.

---

### 2. Setup  

| Item | How to Prepare |
|------|----------------|
| Deck | Standard Uno deck (108 cards: 25 red, 25 yellow, 25 green, 25 blue + 8 special cards per color + 4 Wild cards). |
| Players | 2–10 players. |
| Deal | Each player draws 7 cards. |
| Starting pile | Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile. Turn the top card face up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, follow its effect immediately (see §5). |
| Scoreboard | Keep track of points on paper or a digital app. |

---

### 3. Card Types  

| Color | Card | Value | Effect |
|-------|------|-------|--------|
| Red/Yellow/Green/Blue | Number (0–9) | Face value | Normal play |
| Same colors | Skip | 20 pts | Next player loses turn |
| Same colors | Reverse | 20 pts | Order of play reverses |
| Same colors | Draw Two | 20 pts | Next player draws two cards and loses turn |
| Any color | Wild | 50 pts | Player chooses next color |
| Any color | Wild Draw Four | 50 pts | Player chooses next color; next player draws four cards and loses turn (must be played only if no matching color in hand – see §6) |

---

### 4. Gameplay  

1. **Turn Order** – Players sit in a circle. Play proceeds clockwise unless a Reverse card changes direction.  
2. **Playing a Card** – On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.  
   * Example: If the top card is a red 7, you can play any red card or any 7 of any color.  
3. **Wild Cards** – When playing a Wild or Wild Draw Four, you immediately declare the next color to play.  
4. **Drawing** – If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile.  
   * If the drawn card can be played immediately, you may do so on the same turn.  
   * If not, your turn ends.  
5. **Calling “Uno”** – When you have **exactly one card left**, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn.  
   * Failure to call UNO when required results in a penalty: draw two cards.  
6. **Winning a Round** – The first player to discard all seven cards wins the round.  
   * They receive points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players.  
   * If a player has a Wild or Wild Draw Four in hand, they count as 50 points each.  
7. **Next Round** – After scoring, shuffle the discard pile into a new draw pile and deal again. The winner of the previous round starts the next round.  

---

### 5. Special Card Effects  

| Card | Immediate Effect | Penalty for Opponent |
|------|------------------|----------------------|
| Skip | Next player loses turn | None |
| Reverse | Order of play reverses | None |
| Draw Two | Next player draws two cards | Loses turn |
| Wild | Player chooses next color | None |
| Wild Draw Four | Player chooses next color | Next player draws four cards and loses turn (only playable if you have no matching color – see §6) |

---

### 6. Wild Draw Four Rules (Optional but common)

* A Wild Draw Four **may only be played** if the player has **no card that matches the current color**.  
* If a player believes the Wild Draw Four was played illegally, they can challenge.  
  * The challenger must show their hand.  
  * If the challenger actually had a matching color, the challenger draws four cards instead of the original penalty.  
  * If the challenger had no matching color, the original player draws four cards.  

---

### 7. Scoring & Winning the Game  

| Round Winner | Points Earned |
|--------------|---------------|
| Sum of opponent cards | 0–9 cards: face value; Skip/Reverse/Draw Two: 20; Wild/Wild Draw Four: 50 |

* The game continues until a player reaches or exceeds the target score (commonly 500).  
* If a player reaches the target mid‑round, the round still finishes and the final score is added.  

---

### 8. Variations (Optional)

| Variation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they also play a matching special card. |
| **No Challenge** | Wild Draw Four can be played at any time; no challenge rule. |
| **Speed Uno** | Players must play as fast as possible; no “UNO” call. |
| **House Rules** | Many families add custom rules (e.g., “Draw One” instead of “Draw Two”). |

---

### 9. Quick Reference Cheat Sheet  

| Situation | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Top card is a number | Play same number or same color |
| Top card is a special | Play same special or same color |
| You have no playable card | Draw one; play if possible |
| You have one card left | Call “UNO!” |
| You play a Wild | Declare next color |
| You play a Wild Draw Four | Declare next color; next player draws 4 unless challenged |
| You’re challenged and you had a matching color | You draw 4 |
| You’re challenged and you had no matching color | Opponent draws 4 |

---

**Enjoy your game!**  
Feel free to tweak the rules to suit your group—Uno is all about fun and flexibility.
